selection: Highest independently re-evaluated best-checkpoint AP, separately per model/cohort
core_grid: legacy640 multiscale / fixed640 / fixed1024 x MixUp 0 / .5; Mosaic 0, IoUCrop .8, ZoomOut .5
refinement: Three separate single-factor trials on each core winner: IoUCrop .5, ZoomOut 0, or Mosaic .25. No untested combinations are claimed optimal.
tie_break: AP descending, then smaller evaluation size, lower Mosaic, lower MixUp, higher crop/zoom, lexical job ID
retention: Keep every candidate config/log/metrics and best.pth; delete only native temporary last/stage weights after successful final re-evaluation.
scope: Exploratory bounded validation selection, not globally optimal or a locked-test/SOTA claim.
